highlights: Developed interactive learning modules and coding challenges to enhance understanding of DSA and Machine Learning.
Engineered problem-solving exercises that strengthened algorithmic thinking and coding proficiency among learners.
Authored well-documented code and debugged critical issues to maintain system efficiency.

Designing and building a multi-tenant waste traceability SaaS that traces hospital and hotel waste from generation to recycling, with a dedicated recycler portal for managing incoming pickups and issuing verifiable certificates.
Designed a multi-tenant data model with department-scoped access control, tracking every waste entry through a defined Pending → Collected → Processed → Certified lifecycle.

Containerized the stack with a multi-stage Dockerfile and deployed to AWS ECS (Fargate) behind an Application Load Balancer, provisioned through a dedicated least-privilege IAM user rather than root-level access.
Debugged a TypeScript monorepo build-output issue and stale-cache rendering bugs in production.
